before_statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,k)$ be regular local of dimension $d$ and $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$. The following are equivalent: $R/I$ is regular; $I$ is generated by an initial part of a regular system of parameters; and $\dim_k((I+\mathfrak m^2)/\mathfrak m^2)=d-\dim(R/I)$.
